name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: A horizontal bar of menus, like File, Edit and View in a desktop app.
a11y: role="menubar"; arrow keys move between menus and items, Enter or Space opens.
Escape closes the open menu and returns focus to its trigger.
usage:
import {Menubar, MenubarContent, MenubarItem, MenubarMenu, MenubarSeparator, MenubarTrigger} from '@monoline/react';

<Menubar aria-label="Application">
  <MenubarMenu>
    <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
    <MenubarContent>
      <MenubarItem>New file</MenubarItem>
      <MenubarItem>Open</MenubarItem>
      <MenubarSeparator />
      <MenubarItem>Quit</MenubarItem>
    </MenubarContent>
  </MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarMenu>
    <MenubarTrigger>Edit</MenubarTrigger>
    <MenubarContent>
      <MenubarItem>Undo</MenubarItem>
      <MenubarItem>Redo</MenubarItem>
    </MenubarContent>
  </MenubarMenu>
</Menubar>
